scenes.title: Reminder
scenes.caption: A council tax reminder: one instalment is missing.
scenes.say: This is a reminder from Riverford District Council. One of your Council Tax instalments hasn't been paid, so let's look at what to do.

scenes.title: What's missing
scenes.caption: The November instalment was due on 1 November 2026.
scenes.say: The council says the November instalment of one hundred and forty-eight pounds, due on the first of November, hasn't arrived.

scenes.title: Pay in 7 days
scenes.caption: Pay £148.00 within 7 days of the notice date.
scenes.say: The fix is simple. Pay the one hundred and forty-eight pounds within seven days of the date on the notice, and carry on with instalments as before.

scenes.title: If you don't
scenes.caption: Miss it, and the rest of the year's bill falls due.
scenes.say: Miss that deadline, and you lose instalments. The remaining seven hundred and forty pounds is due at once. After that, court action and eighty-five pounds in costs are possible.

scenes.title: How to pay
scenes.caption: Pay online, by phone, or at a Post Office.
scenes.say: You can pay online, by phone at any hour, or at a Post Office or PayPoint with the barcode on your bill.

scenes.title: Need help
scenes.caption: Struggling? Contact the council straight away.
scenes.say: If money is tight, contact the council straight away. You may get a reduction or a single person discount, and Citizens Advice offers free debt advice. Already paid? Ignore this. For anything unclear, check with the council.
